'''Gactimus' Halo''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Triton (star)|Triton]] in the [[Triton system/Legends|Triton system]]. It was located in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], it was situated beyond the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Triton/Legends|Triton]].
